assertions.name: identifies-correct-cause
assertions.description: Identifies the root cause of a Prisma auth connection failure

assertions.name: provides-fix-command
assertions.description: Provides concrete fix command or config change

assertions.name: includes-ssl-consideration
assertions.description: Checks SSL/TLS requirements for the database URL

assertions.name: suggests-verification
assertions.description: Suggests how to verify the fix worked

assertions.name: follows-debug-workflow
assertions.description: Follows a systematic debug process (reproduce, isolate, fix, verify)

prompt: Debug this: A Next.js app with Prisma works locally but in production (Railway) it randomly throws 'Can't reach database server' every few minutes. The database is Neon Postgres with PgBouncer connection pooling. Trace the root cause.
